newsitem.title: USA: Prudential denies Humana buyout talk.
newsitem.headline: Prudential denies Humana buyout talk.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America denied it is planning to acquire health maintenance organization Humana Inc.
The denial came in response to an item in the March 17 issue of BusinessWeek that focused on possible acquirers for Humana, including Prudential.

"We've been saying we intend to grow and build healthcare systems in the markets where we're strong and make changes where we're weak," said Prudential spokesman Kevin Heine. "But regarding Humana, there's no truth to the rumor."
Humana declined comment on the BusinessWeek item, which also mentioned CIGNA Corp as a potential buyer.
A spokeswoman for Humana said the company actively evaluates acquisition opportunites but avoids commenting on rumors of such activity as a matter of policy.
CIGNA Corp also declined to comment on the item.
Shares in Humana rose 1-1/8 to 22 and CIGNA shares gained 4-1/8 to 154-1/2 amid a broad rally in insurance and other financial shares.
